name: Acid Rock 1

grid.note: ASCII uses a 1/32 grid. Humanized notes within ±½×32nd snap to the nearest slot. hardOffNotes = onsets farther than that (shown in pattern stats). Exact ticks remain in current.json.

forAssistant: Read overview.md ASCII patterns per section first (1/32 grid, humanize-aware). Then current.json for exact ticks/velocity. Prefer markers/sections for form. Use markers/sections and the user's requested bar range for targeted edits.
